summary: Sidus Space Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a placement agency agreement with ThinkEquity LLC for a best-efforts offering of 16,485,038 shares of Class A common stock at $5.08 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 3,200,001 shares at $5.0799 each, expecting ~$100 million gross proceeds. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation transaction.
